root.label: Rabbi Eliyahu calls for atom bomb on Gaza

events.label: Rabbi Eliyahu calls for atom bomb on Gaza

slots.name: lecture date
slots.sentence: Rabbi Eliyahu, who for decades has served as chief rabbi of Safed, a public office in Israel, remarked of Palestinians in Gaza in a lecture his office posted to YouTube in November 2023, “Drop an atom [bomb] on them? It’s an option,” he said.
